rows: - 16 Nov, `wf check --layout` in lefthook and CI, the generated shape table, the help statement (issue #83 H7; test type: flow tests for the table and the help plus a real run on the repo, n=1). Real run: 138 packages, 111 typed, 109 passing, 27 unlisted (all 27 in `layout-known.json`), 34 known findings, 0 new, 15 generated regions, 0 drift; by type `cli-crate` 39/39, `rust-group` 11/11, `rust-core` 8/8, `rust-contract` 20/21. Check time through `cargo run -q -p wf-lazy -- check --layout --strict` (the hook's command, debug build): 0.48 s and 0.49 s wall warm, and 0.96 s inside the real pre-commit run; two earlier runs of the same binary in the same session took 12.6 s and 20.7 s (user 21 s and 38 s, load average about 2 while other builds ran), cause not isolated, so quote 0.5 s warm and treat the long runs as a cold-cache or contention outlier. New: region `shape-table` (`docs/solutions/architecture/package-shapes.md`, one row per type, regenerated by `--write`), the hook glob now also lists the generated files, the `Architecture` workflow runs `wf check --layout --strict` in `root-checks` (that workflow is dispatch-only, so CI proof is a manual dispatch or the checkpoint run), and `wf check --help` says a pass proves shape and edges only. Not measured: the check on a release build, the `Architecture` workflow run, the hook's real wall time on a commit.
